title: Cairnwatch and the Barrow-King
changes: Cairnwatch, the Cairn Wardens' hill-fort in the Grey Barrow Moors, is open: a safe square with a portal stone, a bounty board, Mother Ysolde's flasks and Gorm's armour.
Seven new monsters haunt the moors: Barrow-Wights, Bog Hags, Bone Hounds, Mist Wraiths, Host Legionaries, Cairn-Lords and, at night, the Barrow-King.
Warden-Captain Edra Vane has a new eight-part quest chain that takes you from the Grey Ring to the Barrow-King's mound.
Signposts now mark the moor roads.
